title: Check Lane Zone Configuration Using the Zone Config (Aveva API) Page
summary: Use the AVEVA HMI “Zone Config Aveva API” page to fetch and verify the current lane-to-zone assignments and processing sequence numbers using “Get Zone Configuration,” then confirm the displayed configuration matches the expected zone configuration state.
when_to_use: When you need to verify the current lane-to-zone assignments and processing sequence numbers shown in the system’s Zone Config Aveva API interface, and determine whether the displayed configuration matches the expected zone configuration state.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the live check on the AVEVA HMI Zone Config Aveva API page and interpret whether lane/zone/sequence data appears missing or inconsistent.
access_or_tools_needed: AVEVA HMI / Zone Config page (site-visible interface)

access_required: AVEVA HMI / Zone Config page access

visual_references.description: Zone Config Aveva API page interface showing lane assignments, zones, processing sequence numbers, and the “Get Zone Configuration” control.

steps.title: Open the AVEVA HMI Zone Config Aveva API page
steps.purpose: Access the interface that displays lane assignments, their zones, and processing sequence numbers.
steps.instruction: Open the AVEVA HMI Zone Config page that shows the “Zone Config Aveva API” interface with lane assignments, zones, and processing sequence numbers.
steps.expected_result: The “Zone Config Aveva API” interface is visible and includes the lane assignment overview with zones and processing sequence numbers, along with the “Get Zone Configuration” function/control.
steps.healthy_condition: The page loads and the “Get Zone Configuration” control is present on the Zone Config Aveva API interface.
steps.failure_condition: The Zone Config Aveva API interface does not load, or the “Get Zone Configuration” control is not visible.

actions.label: Open Zone Config Aveva API page
actions.exact_action: Open the AVEVA HMI Zone Config page that shows the “Zone Config Aveva API” interface with lane assignments, zones, and processing sequence numbers.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Zone Config Aveva API page provides an overview of lane assignments, their respective zones, and the processing sequence numbers; includes “Get Zone Configuration” to fetch the current configuration of all lanes.

steps.title: Locate the “Get Zone Configuration” control/button
steps.purpose: Identify the function used to fetch the current configuration of all lanes.
steps.instruction: On the Zone Config Aveva API page, locate the “Get Zone Configuration” control/button.
steps.expected_result: The “Get Zone Configuration” control/button is located and ready to be clicked/activated.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Get Zone Configuration” control/button is visible on the Zone Config Aveva API interface.
steps.failure_condition: The “Get Zone Configuration” control/button is missing or cannot be found on the page.

actions.label: Find Get Zone Configuration
actions.exact_action: Locate the “Get Zone Configuration” control/button on the Zone Config Aveva API page.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR shows “Get Zone Configuration” on the Zone Config Aveva API page.

steps.title: Click “Get Zone Configuration” to fetch current lane configuration
steps.purpose: Retrieve the current configuration of all lanes (lane-to-zone assignments and processing sequence numbers).
steps.instruction: Click “Get Zone Configuration” on the Zone Config Aveva API page to fetch the current configuration of all lanes.
steps.expected_result: The page updates/refreshed data is loaded after activating “Get Zone Configuration.”
steps.healthy_condition: The lane/zone/processing sequence data refreshes and becomes populated on the page.
steps.failure_condition: No update occurs, or the lane configuration data does not populate after clicking “Get Zone Configuration.”

actions.label: Fetch lane zone configuration
actions.exact_action: Click “Get Zone Configuration” to fetch the current configuration of all lanes.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Get Zone Configuration” fetches the current configuration of all lanes, providing visibility into how each lane is set up within the system.

steps.title: Verify lane assignments, zones, and processing sequence numbers are populated
steps.purpose: Confirm the fetched configuration is displayed and includes lane-to-zone assignments and processing sequence numbers.
steps.instruction: After “Get Zone Configuration,” observe the page to confirm it displays lane assignments with their respective zones and processing sequence numbers (i.e., the configuration list/table is populated).
steps.expected_result: The Zone Config Aveva API page shows lane assignment entries populated with each lane’s assigned zone and processing sequence number.
steps.healthy_condition: Lane configuration entries are present (not empty) and include zone and processing sequence number fields/columns/values.
steps.failure_condition: Lane configuration data is missing/empty, or zone/processing sequence information is not displayed as expected.

actions.label: Check populated configuration rows
actions.exact_action: Observe that the page displays lane assignments with their respective zones and processing sequence numbers for the lanes (i.e., the configuration list/table is populated).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the displayed lane configuration data is missing/empty after “Get Zone Configuration.”
Stop and escalate if lane-to-zone assignments or processing sequence numbers appear inconsistent with the expected zone configuration state for the job.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Zone Config Aveva API page provides overview of lane assignments, their respective zones, and processing sequence numbers; “Get Zone Configuration” fetches current configuration of all lanes.

success_criteria: After clicking “Get Zone Configuration,” the Zone Config Aveva API page shows populated lane assignment entries including each lane’s assigned zone and processing sequence number.
The displayed lane-to-zone assignments and processing sequence numbers match the expected zone configuration state for the job.
healthy_conditions: Zone Config Aveva API page shows lane configuration entries populated with zone and processing sequence number values after “Get Zone Configuration.”
failure_conditions: Lane configuration data is missing/empty after “Get Zone Configuration.”
Lane-to-zone assignments or processing sequence numbers appear inconsistent with the expected zone configuration state for the job.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if lane configuration data is missing/empty after “Get Zone Configuration,” or if lane-to-zone assignments/processing sequence numbers do not match the expected zone configuration state for the job.

missing_details: The packet does not provide explicit navigation steps to reach the Zone Config Aveva API page from another screen; this runbook assumes the Zone Config page is already open.
The packet does not provide the exact expected lane/zone/processing sequence values to compare against; the operator must use the job’s expected zone configuration state (not included in the packet).
